spec.description:
Autex Verve - Surface Finishes is a three-dimensional contoured acoustic wall
panel combining expressive architectural forms with digitally printed stone and
textural finishes. Made from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core,
it turns static walls into sculptural features that interact with light and
shadow. Available in six distinctive contoured profiles and a curated selection
of marble, travertine, and concrete prints, it delivers acoustic comfort
(NRC 0.30+) and Group 1 fire compliance without the structural weight of real
masonry.
features:
Sculptural contoured profiles: Pillar, Flute, Ovolo,
Pinstripe, Ridge, Windswept

High-definition digital printing of realistic
stone, marble, and concrete textures

Printed with safe, water-based, UV-cured
ink without degrading acoustic performance

Constructed from 100% polyester
fibre with minimum 80% recycled PET

Available in 12mm (6mm edge) and 21mm
(15mm edge) thicknesses

Standard full-height panel dimensions of 2680mm
or 2700mm height by 1170mm width
Acoustic rating of NRC 0.30 and higher
Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1
Compatible with SpinFix mechanical mounting or direct adhesive fixing
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install:
Confirm substrate is plumb, flat, and
dry

Inspect stone or texture pattern alignment across all panels before
fitting

Apply high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across panel back or use
SpinFix clips

Position panel, butt edges tightly at pattern low points, and
press firmly across face

Ensure seamless continuity of contoured profile
across adjacent panels

Trim top and bottom edges carefully with a track saw
or fine-toothed blade

Select thickness (12mm with 6mm edge or 21mm with 15mm edge)

Choose fixing method (adhesive direct-fix or
SpinFix clips)
limitations:
Indoor
use only; avoid wet areas or direct water exposure

available in 12mm only

Panels must be installed in uniform vertical
orientation

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Verve - Surface Finishes combines 3D contoured acoustic
wall geometry with high-definition digital UV printing of natural stone, marble,
and concrete textures. Constructed from 100% polyester fibre with an 80%
recycled PET core, it is available in six sculptural profiles and two
thicknesses (12mm and 21mm) in 2680mm x 1170mm sheets. Delivering an acoustic
absorption rating of NRC 0.30+ and Group 1 fire compliance under AS ISO 9705, it
replicates the high-end aesthetic of fluted masonry without structural weight,
installation complexity, or acoustic harshness.
